t.zh: 到这里，任务都是由物体求像。这一关反过来问：看到像有多高，能定出物体有多远吗？焦距固定为 f = 2。每一轮给出几组（物高, 距离），选出像高都是 1、距离又各不相同的那几组，全部选对、一组不多才算对。
t.en: So far every task has gone from the object to its image. This level asks the other way: does the height of an image tell how far away the object is? The focal length is fixed at f = 2. Each round lists several (height, depth) pairs; choose those that all image 1 tall at different depths, all of them and no others.

after.zh: 像只定出物高和距离的比 H/Z：大而远和小而近成同一个像，这是<wiki-ref to="inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>在相机上的样子。
after.en: An image fixes only the ratio H/Z: large-and-far and small-and-near image alike — the <wiki-ref to="inverse-problem"></wiki-ref> as the camera poses it.

brief.zh: f = 2：选出像高都是 1、距离各不相同的两组以上。
brief.en: With f = 2, choose two or more pairs that all image 1 tall, each at its own depth.

hint.zh: 物高和距离一起翻倍时，像高怎样变？
hint.en: When height and depth double together, what happens to the image height?

prompt.zh: 哪几组的像高都是 1、距离又各不相同？
prompt.en: Which pairs all image 1 tall at different depths?

prompt.zh: 换一批：哪几组的像高都是 1、距离又各不相同？
prompt.en: A new batch: which pairs all image 1 tall at different depths?
